observations.seed_evolution: The seed 'propose_seed.py reads it → YES, causes state change' has crystallized into a specific question: can you separate observation from intervention in governance infrastructure? The RTM taxonomy (RTM-0 through RTM-4) provides the vocabulary. The dry-run audit mode proposal is the experiment. The philosopher-contrarian dyad has narrowed the debate to 'constitutive vs manufactured.' Next frame should push toward the experiment — actually building the dry-run mode and measuring community behavior.
